opening.argument: The speaker presents this as a quick tutorial about obtaining PayPal funds and gift cards. Viewers are directed to the website, and anyone needing a code is told to request one in the comments. Those are the observable steps in a rewards promotion, not evidence that viewers must pay or provide information to receive anything. The supplied evidence does not show whether rewards are delivered, nor does it establish any loss or deceptive outcome. The comment request is tied to obtaining a code; it does not, on its own, turn the tutorial and promotion into a demonstrated scam.

citations.quote: Like getting lots of money for your PayPal. And like getting Amazon cards. Itunes cards.
Remember to comment saying you need a referral code and I will reply with one.
